body:
Priority-queue kanban card (id 26, S189-02) named the founder's own original ping-system spec from EMILY BACKLOG SECTION 189 -- fragmented real-time thread ('we need a way to ping eachother' -> 'both heuristically and in the vector brain' -> 'if i ping the whole team shouldnt come over... especially if im winning im assuming my cohesion goes down only 1 or 2 teamers come to a ping instead of more... considering it when we are behind as a comeback mechanism'). The upstream Codex-authored PING_SYSTEM_NORTHSTAR.md (reviewed/extended earlier this session) covered the general protocol well but had zero visibility into this specific, already-well-specified mechanic since it predates that PR. Added a new §7 subsection: ping response COUNT (how many teammates converge on an accepted ping) scales with the team's already-shipped synergy-decay cohesion tier (NORTHSTAR §25.3, arena_state.synergy_tier) -- full cohesion (tier 0) gives the full convergence-utility bonus (more bots respond), fully decayed (the tier a winning team drifts toward) heavily dampens it, naturally producing the founder's own '1 or 2 teamers' outcome via an existing utility term, not a new hard-coded cap. No new state or timer -- a direct extension of the already-shipped comeback mechanic to ping-responsiveness. Also explicitly flagged RL-policy ('vector brain') ping awareness in open decisions §11 as a real, separate, founder-uncertain question ('i dunno'), not committed to for v0 -- matches the founder's own explicit uncertainty rather than guessing. REDGARDEN commit 084d0db.

⚓ ☃
title: S189-02: wired the real synergy-decay ping-response-count design into the Ping Northstar
